verses.ar: ثُمَّ مَرَّ بِقُدَيْدٍ عَلٰى أُمِّ مَعْبَدٍ الْخُزَاعِيَّةْ ۞ وَأَرَادَ ابْتِيَاعَ لَحْمٍ أَوْ لَبَنٍ مِنْهَا فَلَمْ يَكُنْ شَيْءٌ مِنْ ذَلِكَ خِبَاؤُهَا قَدْ حَوَاهْ ۞ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى شَاةٍ فِي الْبَيْتِ خَلَّفَهَا الْجَهْدُ عَنِ الرَّعِيَّةْ ۞ فَاسْتَأْذَنَهَا فِي حَلْبِهَا فَأَذِنَتْ وَقَالَتْ لَوْ كَانَ بِهَا حَلْبٌ لَأَصَبْنَاهْ ۞ فَمَسَحَ الضَّرْعَ مِنْهَا وَدَعَا اللّٰهَ مَوْلَاهُ وَوَلِيَّهْ
verses.tr: Thumma marra bi-Qudaydin ʿalā Ummi Maʿbadin l-Khuzāʿiyyah, wa-arāda-btiyāʿa laḥmin aw labanin minhā fa-lam yakun shay'un min dhālika khibā'uhā qad ḥawāh, fa-naẓara ilā shātin fī l-bayti khallafaha l-jahdu ʿani r-raʿiyyah, fa-s-ta'dhanahā fī ḥalbihā fa-adhinat wa-qālat law kāna bihā ḥalbun la-aṣabnāh, fa-masaḥa ḍ-ḍarʿa minhā wa-daʿā Llāha mawlāhu wa-waliyyah.
verses.en: Then, passing through Qudayd, he came upon Umm Ma'bad al-Khuza'iyyah and wished to purchase some meat or milk from her, but her tent contained none of either. He then noticed a ewe by the tent that weakness had kept behind from the grazing flock. He asked her permission to milk it, and she consented, saying, “Had there been any milk in it, we would have found it.” He then stroked its udder and supplicated to Allah, his Lord and Protector.

verses.ar: فَدَرَّتْ فَحَلَبَ وَسَقَى كُلًّا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ وَأَرْوَاهْ ۞ ثُمَّ حَلَبَ وَمَلَأَ الْإِنَاءَ وَغَادَرَهُ لَدَيْهَا آيَةً جَلِيَّةْ ۞ فَجَاءَ أَبُو مَعْبَدٍ وَرَأَى اللَّبَنَ فَذَهَبَ بِهِ الْعَجَبُ إِلَى أَقْصَاهْ ۞ وَقَالَ أَنَّى لَكِ هَذَا وَلَا حَلُوبَ فِي الْبَيْتِ تَبِضُّ بِقَطْرَةٍ لَبَنِيَّةْ ۞ فَقَالَتْ مَرَّ بِنَا رَجُلٌ مُبَارَكٌ كَذَا وَكَذَا جُثْمَانُهُ وَمَعْنَاهْ ۞ فَقَالَ لَهَا هَذَا صَاحِبُ قُرَيْشٍ وَأَقْسَمَ بِكُلِّ أَلِيَّةْ ۞ بِأَنَّهُ لَوْ رَآهُ لَآمَنَ بِهِ وَاتَّبَعَهُ وَأَدْنَاهْ
verses.tr: Fa-darrat fa-ḥalaba wa-saqā kullan mina l-qawmi wa-arwāh, thumma ḥalaba wa-mala'a l-inā'a wa-ghādarahu ladayhā āyatan jaliyyah, fa-jā'a Abū Maʿbadin wa-ra'ā l-labana fa-dhahaba bihi l-ʿajabu ilā aqṣāh, wa-qāla annā laki hādhā wa-lā ḥalūba fī l-bayti tabiḍḍu bi-qaṭratin labaniyyah, fa-qālat marra bi-nā rajulun mubārakun kadhā wa-kadhā juthmānuhu wa-maʿnāh. Fa-qāla lahā hādhā ṣāḥibu Qurayshin wa-aqsama bi-kulli aliyyah, bi-annahu law ra'āhu la-āmana bihi wa-ttabaʿahu wa-adnāh.
verses.en: And its milk flowed abundantly, so he milked it and gave everyone among the group to drink until their thirst was quenched. Then he milked it again, filled the vessel, and left it with her as a manifest sign. And when Abu Ma'bad returned and saw the milk, his astonishment reached its utmost. He said, “Where did you get this when there is no milk-giving animal in the tent that could yield even a single drop of milk?” She replied, “A blessed man passed by us,” and proceeded to describe his physical appearance and his qualities. He said to her, “This is the man of Quraysh,” and swore with every solemn oath that, had he seen him, he would have believed in him, followed him, and drawn him close.

verses.ar: وَقَدِمَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْمَدِينَةَ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ ثَانِيَ عَشَرَ رَبِيعٍ الْأَوَّلِ وَأَشْرَقَتْ بِهِ أَرْجَاؤُهَا الزَّكِيَّةْ ۞ وَتَلَقَّاهُ الْأَنْصَارُ وَنَزَلَ بِقُبَاءَ وَأَسَّسَ مَسْجِدَهَا عَلٰى تَقْوَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-qadima ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama l-Madīnata yawma l-ithnayni thāniya ʿashara rabīʿin l-awwali wa-ashraqat bihi arjā'uha z-zakiyyah, wa-talaqqāhu l-Anṣāru wa-nazala bi-Qubā'a wa-assasa masjidahā ʿalā taqwāh.
verses.en: The Prophet, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, arrived in al-Madinah on Monday, the twelfth of Rabi al-Awwal, and its pure horizons were illuminated by his presence. And the Ansar welcomed him, and he settled in Quba, where he founded its mosque upon piety.

verses.ar:
عَطِّرِ اللّٰهُمَّ قَبْرَهُ الْكَرِيمَ بِعَرْفٍ شَذِيٍّ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَتَسْلِيمٍ
اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr:
ʿAṭṭiri Llāhumma qabrahu l-karīma bi-ʿarfin shadhiyyin min ṣalātin wa-taslīmin.
Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalayhi.
verses.en:
O Allah, perfume his noble grave with a fragrant scent of prayers and peace.
O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon him.
